parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description:
<props="china">The name of the PolarDB-X privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty. For more information about privileged accounts, see [Account management](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98664.html).</props>

<props="intl">The name of the DRDS privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty.</props>.

parameters.name: DbInstType
parameters.description: The database storage type. Valid values: **POLARDB** and **RDS**.

parameters.name: DbInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the storage-layer database belongs.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description:
<props="china">The password of the PolarDB-X privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty. For more information about privileged accounts, see [Account management](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98664.html).</props>

<props="intl">The password of the DRDS privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty.</props>.
